answers.core: It's an enhancement in the debugging and testing department and I really don't see how having categories and groups in the Inspector for remote nodes can cause any harm. It could even be an option or toggle button for displaying categories/groups if users prefer the current way, so everybody is happy.
answers.workaround: - can have an option or toggle for groups/categories, so anybody can chose their preferred way of working with exported properties in remote nodes

title: Use ExportCategory and ExportGroup inside Inspector for exported properties
